title: AAPSClient predictions doesn't always get updated correctly after new BG / looprun is received
body:
Every so often when new BG / loop-run is received on AAPSClient the predictions in overview screen isn't updated to latest available data. It seem to be updating to the previous BG / loopdata. Workaround is to press tap "6h" and select it again for it to process with latest data from AAPS.  Issue is present on master and latest dev.
